explanation: This payment screenshot exhibits high risk of digital tampering. A screenshot alone can easily be forged using fake payment receipt generators or editing apps. The threat to file a police report within 1 hour is a classic pressure tactic.
next_steps: A screenshot cannot prove a payment. Confirm in your bank app or official bank SMS.
Do NOT dispatch any goods or courier parcels until money is reflected in your bank account.
Do not call back or engage with threats of police action.
If pressured, block the sender and file an inquiry on cybercrime.gov.in.

family_alert.title: ⚠️ Caution: Payment Screenshot Deception Warning
family_alert.body: Never dispatch goods or transfer refund money simply because someone shows you a payment screenshot. Always log into your own bank app to verify actual credit.
tips: A screenshot is not proof of payment.
Check your bank balance directly in your bank application.
Ignore threats of immediate police action.

limitations: This assessment is based exclusively on the provided text and imagery. Absence of detected red flags does not guarantee authenticity.
